extension.summary: 言語設定マネージャー
extension.description: 根据你的语言偏好自动选择音轨与字幕轨道
Sets the audio and subtitle track according to your language preferences
Ställer in ljud- och undertextspår enligt dina språkinställningar
Imposta le tracce audio e dei sottotitoli in base alle preferenze linguistiche.
言語設定に従って音声トラックと字幕トラックを設定します。
Legt die Audio- und Untertitelspur entsprechend Ihren Spracheinstellungen fest
Définit les pistes audio et de sous-titres selon vos préférences linguistiques

extension.news: 1.1.1Beta2 : - Builds on 1.1.1Beta1. - Regional/script language variants (English UK/US/Australia/India/Canada, Spanish Spain/Latin America, French France/Canada/Belgium/Switzerland, Portuguese Portugal/Brazil, Chinese Simplified/Traditional, German Switzerland/Austria, Dutch Belgium) share one engine; the region is read from the track tag, title or external subtitle file name. - New: subtitle format preference (issue #30): rank SRT, ASS/SSA, WebVTT, PGS and VobSub in General settings; among subtitles that fit your language preference equally well, the first format of your list that is present is used. - Reworked seekback / "Fast Subtitles Display" ("Start & Resume" by default). - Regex subtitle filter fixes; external subtitle languages read from file names; safer stored preferences. - The settings values of the 1.1.1Beta1 language variants were renumbered: re-select regional languages in settings. - New: each conditional subtitle rule can use its own preferred subtitle format (general order, or the 1st / 2nd / 3rd format of the General settings); custom rules: -f1 / -f2 / -f3. - Fix: subtitle format preference with external subtitle files of the same language (Movie.en.ass + Movie.en.srt): a preferred ASS is no longer passed over for an embedded PGS (.sup). - New: protection against a stale copy: no compiled Python files are used, the log shows the running version and code, and a warning is shown when another copy of the add-on is installed. Settings, General, Installation: "Check installation" says whether the installation is clean. - Fixed: with a subtitle format preference set, a text track (ASS/SRT/WebVTT) that only has the forced/default flag (no "forced" in its name) is no longer excluded from non-forced rules, so the format preference can choose it (e.g. English ASS flagged forced+default with Japanese audio). Flagged image tracks (PGS/VobSub) and tracks named "forced" stay excluded; the unflagged track wins a tie within the same format; without a format preference nothing changes. - Changed: the regex subtitle filter now respects the preferred subtitle language and format. Among the tracks the regex matches, it takes the language of the conditional rule for the playing audio (else the subtitle preferences), then the best format (the rule's 1st/2nd/3rd choice or the general order); the forced/default/original flags and "forced" names do not count there. If no matching track is in a preferred language, the filter works as before (ASS first, forced tracks deferred). 1.1.1Beta1 : - Add regional/script language preferences for English, French, Spanish, Portuguese and Chinese, grouped with their base language in settings (Thanks to Hugs11). - Prefer exact BCP-47 tags or recognized track-title variants, then unlabelled tracks of the same language; preserve generic language preferences (Thanks to Hugs11). - Add Chinese translation (Thanks to wabisabi926). - Avoid some wrong seekback decisions in subtitles delayed workaround.
